create_static_kv_cache: create a StaticKVCache instance with num_layers, num_kv_heads, dim_kv_head, batch_size, device, dtype, and max_length
get_layer_cache: get the key and value cache tensors for a specific layer index from a StaticKVCache instance
step_cache: step the StaticKVCache forward by one token position and return the current cache index
fill_caches: fill the StaticKVCache with existing key-value tensors from a list of layer cache pairs
test_cache_full: test that StaticKVCache raises ValueError when current_length reaches max_length during step
